Getosti's budget is now **$2,095K**. I worked through all 1,600 records once, so the figure has not been independently re-checked.

**Approach**
- Only Finance Office budget actions were counted. Messages from Sales, Engineering and other teams were ignored, as were Finance Office non-budget items (cost center codes, audits, purchase orders).
- I started from the $1730K set in #0001 and applied every Finance Office increase or decrease in order.
- An update was skipped if an effective withdrawal targets it. A withdrawal stops being effective if it is itself withdrawn by an effective withdrawal.

**Withdrawal chains that decide the result**
- **#0002 (+$472K) still counts.** #0161 withdraws #0081, which restores #0032. #0032 withdraws #0015, which restores #0009. #0009 withdraws #0007, so #0007 never took effect.
- **#0003 (+$547K) is withdrawn.** #1164 removes #0154, which restores #0021. #0021 removes #0013, which restores #0012. #0012 withdraws #0003.
- **#0006 (+$27K) is withdrawn.** #0776 removes #0037, which restores #0019. #0019 withdraws #0006.
- **#0071 (+$436K) still counts.** #1250 removes #0150, which restores #0087. #0087 removes #0080, which had withdrawn #0071.
- **#0033 (−$259K) is withdrawn.** #1438 removes #0784, which restores #0708. #0708 removes #0534, which restores #0165. #0165 withdraws #0033.
- **Other chains resolved the same way:**
  - **Withdrawn:** #0206, #0339, #0384, #0533 and #0568.
  - **Still in effect:** #0028, #0051, #0431, #0420, #0686 and #0693.

ANSWER: $2095K
